verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents that users can configure the equation that calculates customer risk scores, which covers the configuration half of the story. Nothing shows a way to see why a score changed: the audit trail is documented only for cases, not for customer risk scores. Missing for 10: documented risk-factor-level configuration details, risk score change history or explanation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure customer risk factors and inspect why the risk score changed

citations.quote: You have the ability to configure the equation that calculates the risk score of your customers.
